config.ad_backend: AutoEnzyme(Reverse, runtime_activity, Const), used by BRM.adaptive_centering_problem
config.controls: the six-arm standard matrix separates WarmupHMC's linear adaptation on generated non-centered/centered targets from the fixed and fitted nonlinear-wrapper paths
config.gradient_counter: WarmupHMC.count_and_time around the generated BRM density for every sampler; the adaptive wrapper is built over the counted inner target
config.inventory_contract: model bodies are read from translations.tsv and cross-checked against model_matrix.tsv; real-data adapters are consumer-side
config.run_order: one untimed preflight per comparison arm; the six recorded arms rotate cyclically by seed to avoid systematic temporal bias
config.warmup_budget: sampler defaults: DynamicHMC uses its default 1000-step Stan-style warmup; WarmupHMC chooses its own gradient-targeted windows
